states.noVehicle: Upper panel receives no query and shows the vehicle prerequisite, not a sentinel-result claim. The lower panel still renders; its dynamic-result claims are covered by BS001.
states.initialFetching: Upper query-aware panel resolves to loading and shared source skeletons. Lower panel is query-unaware: BS001.
states.initialPaused: Upper panel explicitly says evidence query is paused and no empty result is inferred. Lower panel is query-unaware: BS001.
states.initialUnresolvedIdle: Upper panel says evidence availability has not resolved yet. Lower panel is query-unaware: BS001.
states.initialFatal: Upper panel uses fatalError with retry without deleting neighboring shells. Lower panel still implies returned-result absence: BS001.
states.resolvedEmpty: Upper panel presents the supported no-findings message with refresh; lower quality and page limitations can still render. Empty items are not silently converted into measured zero.
states.populated: Finding cards, nested evidence/limitations and summary render from the selected query payload.
states.backgroundRefresh: Upper panel exposes data freshness and retains payload.
states.retainedFailureOrPaused: Upper panel retains content and displays nonblocking trust/recovery. Lower panel retains data but does not receive local query/freshness state: part of BS001; no claim that the entire page lacks a warning.
states.pageClamp: The effect clamps only a successful non-placeholder response with a valid exact total and matching requested offset.
states.vehicleChange: Render-time guarded scope comparison resets page to one before calculating the new offset; the hook key includes vehicle, limit and offset.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: unresolved/failed data is not an authoritative empty or unsupported result
confirmedIssues.detail: The summary panel receives only data fields, not the sentinel query state. Its own InsightPanel defaults to ready. Before any response, or after an initial failure, it says quality metadata is unsupported, no supporting evidence was returned and no additional limitations were returned. The upper panel correctly distinguishes these states, but the lower source-bound assertions do not.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: query.data is undefined -> quality/limitations are undefined and findings is [] -> EvidencePanel normalizes absent data -> its query-free InsightPanel renders result-like absence messages. Retained summary data likewise has no local freshness/retry context even though the upper panel does.
sourceDerivedRepro: Trace an enabled sentinel query with no retained payload and fetchStatus paused, fetching, or an initial fatal error.
At page lines160-163 the summary still mounts with undefined quality/limitations and an empty evidence list.
Trace EvidencePanel's false/empty branches and its query-free InsightPanel: absence messages render independently of the upper loading/paused/error state.

confirmedIssues.fix: A separately assigned fix can thread the existing structural query/source-state through EvidencePanel and its InsightPanel, preserving the shell and static unsupported-attribution explanations while distinguishing dynamic loading, unresolved/paused, fatal, authoritative empty and retained states.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044: consistent user locale/timezone at the display boundary
confirmedIssues.detail: The same page uses settings-bound locale/timezone for finding timestamps but browser-default locale/timezone for observation-window and evidence-source timestamps.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: EvidencePanel imports formatDateTime from lib/dateFormat and passes no FormatOptions. That helper uses browser defaults when opts are absent. The page instead calls useDateFormat, which binds settings locale and the effective user/vehicle/UTC mode.
sourceDerivedRepro: Choose any legitimate settings locale or effective timezone different from browser defaults.
Follow the finding timestamp through the page hook and an evidence/window timestamp through EvidencePanel's no-options call.
Both receive timestamps but resolve different display contexts; changing user preferences cannot bind the latter calls.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no settings were changed and no displayed timestamps were captured
confirmedIssues.fix: Use the existing useDateFormat hook within EvidencePanel, or pass the already bound formatter through its existing feature interface. Preserve null/invalid placeholders and raw timestamps.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044 and frontend i18n instructions: localize UI status labels
confirmedIssues.detail: The quality badge renders the wire enum directly. The finding badge similarly renders severity tokens that the page already interprets as known UI statuses. Neither presentation calls t(), so these labels remain unchanged when the UI language changes.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Badge children are quality.status and finding.severity. Quality is a closed sufficient/limited/insufficient enum; severityVariant recognizes several English status tokens but only changes color.
sourceDerivedRepro: For a supported quality status, trace its value through the Badge children expression.
A language change re-renders translated surrounding labels, but these children remain the original enum strings because no localized presentation mapping is used.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no locale was switched or browser label observed
confirmedIssues.fix: Localize known status labels using existing suitable verdict/severity catalog ownership, retaining raw wire/cache values and explicit fallback handling for unknown severities. Do not translate arbitrary user/server prose as though it were a UI enum.
confirmedIssues.owner: EvidencePanel and sentinel badge presentation; catalog integration only if a verified key is missing

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044: localized counts and correct singular/plural copy
confirmedIssues.detail: Evidence sample captions interpolate a raw numeric count into '{{count}} samples · {{date}}'. The inspected canonical key has no sampleLine_one/sampleLine_other variants. This differs from the same panel's quality sample count, which uses fmtInt.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: count: item.sample_count is passed directly; the template has no number-format directive, and inspected interpolation configuration only disables escaping. A count of one falls back to the base plural noun; counts do not use the user's existing numeric formatter.
sourceDerivedRepro: Follow any supported evidence sample_count equal to one through the existing sampleLine branch; its base English template says '1 samples'.
For a user numeric locale requiring grouping or different digits, compare the quality Samples fmtInt call with the evidence caption's raw count interpolation.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no synthetic evidence object, fixture, i18next execution or API response was created
confirmedIssues.fix: A separately assigned source/catalog fix can preserve numeric count for plural selection, interpolate a separate fmtInt-formatted value, and add normal singular/other variants at the existing canonical/projection owner.
